entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling because I need to make a return. I bought a helmet a little while ago, and I just... I can't keep it. Things are a bit tight this Christmas.
I'm sorry to hear that, but I can certainly look into the return for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I feel terrible about it. I haven't even opened it. The box is unopened, still sealed.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the TrailGuard helmet. It looks like that was delivered about 49 days ago. Is that correct?

Oh, wow. I guess so. Time flies... I really thought I'd use it, I loved the color and everything. But I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I was just hoping you could help me out. I really need this money back.

I completely understand. Let me just confirm the policy for you. One moment... Okay, good news. For a standard item like this helmet, our policy allows for returns within 90 days. You are well within that window.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much. I was so worried.

It's no problem at all. We want to make sure you have the right gear for your safety when you're ready to ride. I've just emailed you a prepaid return label. Since the box is unopened, just attach that label and you can drop it off at any shipping center.
That's fantastic. You have no idea how much this helps. Thank you again, David.
You are very welcome. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed back to the original payment method. Can I help with anything else today?
No, that's everything. Have a good Christmas.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
